label: Selected actual respects inherit every cut to the supply of their bearer's esse
paraphrase: Positive supply of the selected bearer's actuality in the original group interpretation, together with loss of its productive supply under every restriction of admitted groups that removes supply of the same bearer's esse. The intrinsic seeds are fixed. A cut is an operation on supply records. Identifying an actual giver's contribution, a physically admissible change or a respect-specific productive cause needs further evidence.

connection_plan.missing_bridge: A calibration premise on the same records, indices, InAct and esse with three inputs: (i) c is a total cause of x's being; (ii) r is a selected actual respect of x whose supply inherits every cut to the supply of x's esse (this statement); (iii) the records represent c's contribution, that is, the admitted records producing x's esse are c's contribution to x's being. From (i) to (iii) it concludes CausesIn c x r. Together with coverage (every mode of being of x is a selected actual respect of x in the records), this would give TotalCauseCausesModesOfBeing 2f6b9eff for the records' bearers, and with 791fa216 the transfer premise of universalCauseTransfers. It is stated over supply records and does not presuppose 2f6b9eff.
connection_plan.blocker: Supply membership records contribution, not effective responsibility. The populated joint control (Control.Certificate, result 0b462078) satisfies the cut-inheritance interface, 791fa216 and the transfer background while universal transfer b26c10a0 fails under the independently assigned causal table. No warrant is recorded for identifying an actual giver's contribution with the records that a cut removes, and an inherited cut concerns restrictions of records with fixed seeds, not possible worlds (docs/notes/actuality-esse-research.md, section 9).
